nodes.text: Many fishermen were injured in the clash in Chinnammuttam, Kanyakumari district.

Two fishermen were injured after Indian Coast Guard (ICG) personnel fired at the boat they were travelling in off Vizhinjam coast near here ... A heated argument between the two groups escalated into stone pelting, resulting in injuries to fishermen. Following information about the clash ...

claim: Many fishermen were injured in the clash in Chinnammuttam, Kanyakumari district.
